newsitem.title: USA: National Tech measures UPS strike impact.
newsitem.headline: National Tech measures UPS strike impact.

text.p: National TechTeam Inc, a provider of information technology services, said Tuesday the United Parcel Service strike had had no impact on operations as of last Friday, but it has laid off a substantial number of UPS support agents.

TechTeam supports hardware and software placed at customer locations by UPS. That support had continued at UPS's request on a basis consistent with services in prior weeks. The company said it laid off the undisclosed number of support agents at UPS's request.
"At this time, TechTeam cannot estimate the impact that steps it is taking to mitigate the impact of the work stoppage by UPS employees will have," the company said in a statement.

It said operations at a reduced staffing level would continue until the work stoppage is concluded and UPS authorizes TechTeam to restore staffing. Meanwhile, TechTeam's employees are being migrated to open positions in projects with other customers to the extent they are qualified to fill those positions.
